Name: Overgrown Farm
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
The farm is now completely overgrown. Robin has cleared out a small path from the bus to the farmhouse but nothing else.

Grandpa's Shrine is long gone since the farm has been vacant for over a decade. The grass and trees have completed destroyed it. 

Lewis has gotten new furniture for the cabin, but there are still signs of the it being overgrown. 

Farmhouse is pictured using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30744]Solar Panel House[/url]
